# Brennan Center for Justice

> The Brennan Center for Justice is a nonpartisan law and policy institute defending democracy and reforming the justice system through research, litigation, and advocacy.

The center focuses on five core areas: voting rights and election security, money in politics and campaign finance reform, criminal justice reform, judicial independence, and constitutional protection of civil rights. Their work combines empirical research, policy solutions, strategic litigation, and public education to advance democratic participation and equal justice.

## Key Topics

- Democracy & Voting Rights
- Election Security & Integrity
- Campaign Finance & Citizens United
- Criminal Justice Reform
- Judicial Reform
- Constitutional Law
- First Amendment
- Rule of Law
- Civil Rights
- Civic Engagement
- Policy Solutions
- Supreme Court
- Congress & Senate
- Executive Power & Surveillance

## Core Topics & Issues

- [Our Topics](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics): Directory of main topic areas: voting, money in politics, criminal justice, courts
- [Voting & Elections](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/voting-elections): Voting rights, election security, voter suppression, and electoral reform resources
- [Money in Politics](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/money-politics): Campaign finance, Super PACs, Citizens United, and campaign finance reform
- [Criminal Justice](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/criminal-justice): Criminal justice reform, prison policy, sentencing, and incarceration issues
- [The Courts](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/courts): Supreme Court, judicial reform, and federal and state court analysis
- [Government Power](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/government-power): Executive power, surveillance, privacy rights, and rule of law advocacy
- [U.S. Constitution](https://www.brennancenter.org/topics/us-constitution): Constitutional law, First Amendment, Equal Rights Amendment analysis

## Research, Reports & Analysis

- [Research & Reports](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/research-reports): Published research reports on election security, law enforcement, and democracy
- [Policy Solutions](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/policy-solutions): Policy solutions for election security, voting systems, and democracy reform
- [Explainers](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/explainers): Educational explainers on Citizens United, campaign finance, Supreme Court decisions
- [News & Analysis](https://www.brennancenter.org/news-analysis): News analysis on voting rights, immigration, and democracy issues

## Litigation & Legal Action

- [Court Cases](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/court-cases): Litigation and friend-of-the-court briefs challenging policy and legal issues

## Our Work & Organization

- [Our Work](https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work): Overview of Brennan Center's research, policy, and litigation initiatives
- [The Briefing Podcast](https://www.brennancenter.org/podcast): Weekly podcast on politics, democracy, voting rights, and constitutional law
